ownRead.statement:
### E06 — Liu et al. (2017)

**Coupling between distant biofilms and emergence of nutrient time-sharing**  
Science 356, 638–642. DOI: [10.1126/science.aah4204](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aah4204)

**Classification:** supports core / domain-specific realization.  
**Evidence:** Experiment testing a coupled-oscillator prediction.  
**Existing clauses:** §5, §7, §8.

Two biofilms coordinate oscillations; nutrient conditions induce predicted in-phase or antiphase relationships.

**Scope:** A coupled community pair, not physical fusion into one organism.

**Checked:** Primary abstract and detailed figure captions reproduced in PubMed; full manuscript was not accessible.  
**Location:** Abstract; Figures 1–3, especially phase diagrams and experimental validations in Figure 2.  
**Inspected source:** https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28386026/
